test_title: SSC GD Constable (2022) Official Paper (Held On : 10 Jan 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 3.
solution:
The correct answer is** 'Option 1'** i.e. **'Comfortable'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Comfortable **means providing physical ease and relaxation.(आरामदायक)
 
• When candidates with high Emotional Intelligence (EI) are** able to control their emotions** effectively, they create a** comfortable environment** for others.
 
• They can remain calm and composed even in socially awkward situations, which helps put others at ease.
 
• This** emotional stability and control** contribute to making others feel comfortable around them.

Therefore, the **correct sentence **is: *As they are very good at controlling emotions, they make others feel **comfortable**. *

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Let's see the meaning of all other options.
 
 
• **Tolerable **means able to be endured.(संतोषजनक)
 
• **Favourable** means expressing approval.(अनुकूल)
 
• **Manageable **means able to be controlled or dealt with without difficulty (प्रबंधनीय)
